_comment: T-232: variable-ratio loot schedule. Each difficulty (1-5, from mob JSON `difficulty`) maps to integer weights (read as percent-of-100) across rarity tiers. Loot roll: pick ONE tier per kill via these weights, then apply the mob's normal per-item chance/count roll to just the loot entries whose item is that tier. Higher difficulty pushes weight toward better tiers; low difficulty is overwhelmingly common with a small junk tail. Weights per row sum to 100 for readability but are treated as relative weights, not a hard requirement.
